correctness.rationale: The exact impulse-response solution \(v=ru-aW\) is checked from the stated ODE. On its positive interval \(\log u\) is strictly concave in all three eigenvalue types, so \(r=aW/u\) is strictly increasing and determines the first transverse return. Reversed/scaled left flight solves the right equations and proves the exact identity return map and physical period. Explicit u,W expansions yield each dimensionally normalized focus, node and defective-node edge law. The standalone finite checks are consistent with the analytic proof but are not substitutes for it.
